proposed_english: to continue / proceed (lit. 'add unto one's hand')
rationale: Lyc. ⲟⲩⲱⲍ = ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'add' + ⲁⲧⲟⲟⲧϥ̄ 'unto his hand.' Standard Coptic idiom for resumption of speech/action. Recurs as discourse-marker in Kephalaia narrative frame parallel to ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ.

Lyc. = Sah. ⲥⲁϩⲣ 'drive away, expel.' The structuring verb of this kephalaion (8+ occurrences), denoting the cosmic expulsion of dark entities from heaven to earth, then from earth to the climes outside. Preserves vertical-directional and martial semantics.
Standard Coptic ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉ (Crum) — physical food/nourishment. In line 3 paired with ⲍⲏⲩ 'profit' as a doublet for what the expelled darkness becomes within the cosmic refinement-economy.
Lyc. ⲍⲏⲩ = Sah. ϩⲏⲩ 'profit, gain.' Paired with ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉ 'food' in the metaphor of cosmic alchemy: the expelled dark substance becomes both nutrition and economic gain for the Twelve Great Works.

Reduplicated ⲧⲗ̄ⲧⲗ̄ from ⲧⲗ̄ⲧⲓⲗⲉ 'drop, drip.' Designates the descending dark condensation paired with fire — cosmological liquid-form of dark substance falling from heavens to earth. Used 4× in this kephalaion.

proposed_english: they concealed them / shut them up
rationale: Reduplicated form of ϩⲱⲡ 'hide, conceal,' with 3pl object suffix. Manichaean cosmological action of binding the expelled darkness in the outer Zone — completing the triple-stage expulsion (heavens → earth → climes outside).
Tentative — possibly Lyc. variant of ⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ or compound on ⲍⲏⲧ. Functions parallel to ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward' as cosmic-spatial designation of the lower region. Confidence low.

ⲕⲱⲧⲉ 'turn, surround' + ⲁⲛⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'unto the worlds.' The cosmological motif of the encircling river of fire that contains the world-system at its outer boundary. Distinct from homophonous ⲕⲱⲧⲉ as 'circuit' (already in glossary) and ⲕⲱⲧϩ 'pluck.'
